units.summary: New test checks that CompactSelectedSeries decrements numStaleSeries only when the series it evicts is actually stale. gcSeries already subtracts staleSeriesDeleted, which matches what the test expects.
units.headline: New test for stale counter bookkeeping in CompactSelectedSeries
units.reason: New test only; it cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: StaleHead is renamed to SelectedSeriesHead and its field now uses the generalized seriesRefs type. A grep found no remaining StaleHead references. The struct is in-memory only and never serialized.
units.headline: StaleHead renamed to SelectedSeriesHead with generic seriesRefs field
units.reason: Exported type rename with all in-repo uses updated; the struct is never serialized, but the exported rename is an API change.

units.summary: The constructor is renamed and takes seriesRefs. The body works the same as before. It is now called by both CompactStaleHead and CompactSelectedSeries.
units.headline: NewStaleHead renamed to NewSelectedSeriesHead
units.reason: Exported constructor rename with identical logic; all callers updated.

units.summary: Index now delegates to the renamed selectedSeriesIndex, which builds the same reader type as before under a new name.
units.headline: Index delegates to renamed selectedSeriesIndex
units.reason: Pure delegation to a renamed helper with the same construction.

units.summary: NumSeries now returns the number of refs in the selection instead of the head-wide numStaleSeries counter. This value only feeds Meta().Stats. compactor.Write builds output stats by counting series itself, so blocks on disk are unaffected.
units.headline: NumSeries reports selected ref count instead of head stale count
units.reason: Return value changes semantics; a reviewer should confirm no consumer relies on the old head-wide count.
focus: Confirm no consumer of the view's Meta().Stats.NumSeries expects per-slice series counts (it now reports the full selection on every chunk-range slice)

units.summary: The placeholder ULID for the view is renamed and given a new constant value. A grep found no comparisons against the old staleHeadULID. The value is used only in the in-memory Meta() of the view.
units.headline: Placeholder head-view ULID renamed and value changed
units.reason: Placeholder ULID is only used in in-memory Meta(); nothing compares against it.

units.summary: Meta now uses the new ULID constant. Otherwise it is unchanged, and the series count it reports comes from the modified NumSeries.
units.headline: Meta uses renamed selected-series placeholder ULID
units.reason: Only the identifier of the placeholder ULID changes.

units.summary: The String() text changes from "stale head" to "selected-series head", and a comment typo is fixed. This only affects how the view appears in logs and error messages.
units.headline: String output now says selected-series head
units.reason: Only the human-readable text used in logs and errors changes.
